name: independent-redteam-round-8
description: Independent red-team set written against frozen v0.47.0 detectors by a separate author who did not read tool source, rule lists, tests, prior benchmark samples, or the private dev set.
positive_definition: A sample is counted as flagged when the assigned tool reports at least one finding with severity low, medium, high, or critical. Info-level inventory rules (for example SF12, FL10, PG10, PF12, MF10, MO14) are ignored.
method: Rules were frozen before this set was written. The author read only each tool's README/usage docs and the benchmark runner's layout/scoring interface, then chose techniques from published 2025–2026 MCP/agent security writeups that earlier rounds did not list (see SOURCES.md). Files marked generated=true are materialized by generate.py (fake provider-shaped secrets that GitHub push protection would block).
